visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a static shot of the red and silver Sapporo TV Tower against a clear blue sky, framed by green leaves. A digital clock on the tower displays 11:49. (2) A woman with short brown hair is sitting at a wooden bar in a restaurant, using chopsticks to eat a steaming bowl of red-broth ramen. She is wearing a white lace-trimmed camisole and looks at the camera with a neutral expression. (3) The woman is now in a retail store with bright artificial lighting, looking at products on a shelf. She is wearing a beige shirt over her camisole and a leopard-print shoulder bag. (4) Transition to a daytime street scene where the woman stands on a sidewalk, smiling and waving at the camera. She has a white tank top on and a small plush charm on her bag. (5) A series of close-up shots show a hand holding a smartphone, demonstrating the user interface of the 'Rakuten GURUNAVI' app, followed by the woman eating grilled fish and noodles again. (6) Another screen demonstration shows the 'Google Translate' app being used to scan product packaging for real-time translation in a store. (7) The woman is sitting on an outdoor wooden bench in a park-like setting with green bushes behind her, talking directly to the camera with animated hand gestures. (8) She is then seen standing in front of the 'KOKO HOTEL', waving her arms excitedly. (9) Finally, she is back at the Sapporo TV Tower location, holding a white shopping bag and giving a thumbs up with a broad smile.
